book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content: Dijan blanga God en ola pipul
Preya blanga Mosis, det men blanga God.

content.text: YAWEI, brom longtaim yubin oldei jidan laiga seifwan pleis blanga melabat.
Bifo yubin meigim ola hil en meigim dijan wel kamat,
yu na bin oldei jidan det olagijawan God,
en yu garra jidan God olagija.
Wen yu tok, pipul dai en olabat bodi garra gobek langa graun.
Det 1,000 yiya im laik wanbala dei langa yu.
Olabat jis laik yestadei weya im gon olredi,
en jis laik lilbit taim naitaim.
Yu deigidawei melabat jis laik fladwoda.
Melabat jidan nomo longtaim, laik drim wen im binij.
Melabat jidan laiga purdiwan flawa wen im kamat moningtaim,
en im binij sangodantaim.
Wen yu gitwail, yu binijimap melabat.
Melabat brabli bradin langa yu wen yu gitwail nomo lilbit.
Yu pudum ola nogudbalawei blanga melabat lida langa yu,
en ola nogudbala ting weya melabat bin dum sigridwei yu gin luk.
Jis laik wen sambodi opinim en jadimap ai kwikbala,
en lagijat du melabat laif binij kwikbala wen yu gitwail.
Melabat laif maitbi jidan oni 70 yiya o maitbi 80 yiya if wi jidan strongbala,
bat stil melabat abum loda trabul en soriwan filing langa ol detlot yiya.
Detlot yiya binij kwikbala en wi binijap en wi gon.
Nobodi sabi det brabliwan pawa wen yu gitwail langa det nogudbalawei blanga pipul.
Blanga tharran na melabat garra bradin en rispek yu olataim.
Yu lenim melabat hau det laif blanga melabat im shotwan,
wulijim melabat garra jinggabat brabli gudwei.
Haulong mowa yu garra jidan wail lagijat?
YAWEI, yu sori langa yu wekinmen olabat.
Bilimap melabat ebri moning garram det filing blanga yu blanga laigim yu,
wulijim melabat garra sing en jidan gudbinji langa melabat laif olataim.
YAWEI, yu gibit melabat detmatj filing blanga jidan gudbinjiwei na blanga ola yiya weya melabat bin jidan nogudbinjiwei.
Yu larram melabat yu wekinmen olabat, luk ola brabli haibala ting yu dum.
Yu larram melabat biginini olabat hu garra jidan bambai luk yu brabli haibalawan pawa.
YAWEI, melabat God, larram yu kainbala filing jidan garram melabat.
Yu meigim ebrijing melabat wandi dum hepin gudbalawei.
